entities.summary: Brian Greg Cardinal is an American former professional basketball player. Nicknamed "the Custodian" and "the Janitor", he played 456 games in the NBA between 2000 and 2012, and won an NBA championship with the Dallas Mavericks in 2011. Before his NBA career, he played college basketball at Purdue University.
